author: Ebbz
quote: Still the greatest game of all time. Thank you Nintendo for creating this masterpiece and then recreating it for us all to enjoy again.  I felt like a little kid. It took me back to my childhood.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Ebbz
quote: Greatest game of all time. Perfection in every way. Story 10/10. Changed gaming forever.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Ebbz
quote: Not at all what I expected and disappointed with the direction of the game. I think it’s lost what really made it special and what a lot of GTA fans missed for so long. The long wait and it being buggy with low fps is a shame.
